text.text_excerpt: Do yourself a favor and pop in to St Roch Market and visit T2. We had the shrimp spring rolls (2/$7) and they were fresh crunchy and large steamed shrimp with a deliciously creamy peanut sauce just a little bit of spice. We enjoyed every last bite! We also split a pork belly steamy bun (Bao). The bun has a hint of sweet light foamy bread and the pork belly is just Carmelized enough to give it a good crunch along with the fresh veggies. No sauce needed as it is perfectly seasoned. I shared everything on my plate including offering food to a perfect stranger because I wanted everyone to know how good is was! Gave the chef a big hug and promised to be back

Brought a friend to St Roch's Market to check out for her first time. Passed by this place and I just had to order some Baos and the Pork Belly Bites! I ordered the Pork Belly, Pulled Pork, and Hot Sausage Baos and the Char Siu Pork Belly Bites. Of the three baos I ordered, my favorite was surprisingly the Hot Sausage Bao. It was topped off with some sort of mayo sauce that went well with it. The other two baos were good but nothing too spectacular to me. The Pork Belly Bites really amazed me. They were expertly cooked, sauced, and arranged on a wooden board. The presentation was on POINT and they looked delicious! T2 is located inside the St. Roch Market, which is one of my favorite places to chow - and people watch - in the city. I almost always choose something from T2, and have never been disappointed. This is counter service, and your menu is on the back wall. You place your order, pay and they let you know how long your order will be. When it's about time you come back around and pick up whatever delicious morsels you've ordered today, go find a seat in the market, and enjoy. On this visit I had the steamed buns.
